components.name: Tactile Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with subtle tactile elevation and hydro-gradient fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0284c7, #0369a1); color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(2,132,199,0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0369a1, #075985); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(2,132,199,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Recessed Input Field
components.description: Form input field bedded in a soft recessed inset well.
components.css: .ds-input-recessed { width: 100%; background: #e7eeee; color: #0f172a; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 7px rgba(85,113,117,0.14), inset -3px -3px 7px rgba(255,255,255,0.95); outline: none; transition: all 0.18s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input-recessed:focus { background: #ffffff; border-color: #0284c7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(2,132,199,0.18); }

narrative.overview: Bon Laundry Station evokes the crisp, revitalizing cleanliness of pure water and gentle steam through a tactile, modern interface. The experience pairs luminous aquatic hues with physical depth: soft dual-layer convex card surfaces, recessed input wells, and tactile buttons that compress subtly upon interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile Soft Depth: Dual-layer ambient lighting with soft highlights and recessed controls.
Aquatic Cleanliness: Azure and cyan core accents against clean mist and slate foundations.
Editorial Poise: High-contrast serif headlines grounded by geometric, legible data displays.
Live State Fluency: Vibrant emerald, amber, and slate telemetry pills for immediate machine readability.

rules.name: The Clean Tide Rule
rules.body: The saturated Azure accent (#0284c7) is reserved strictly for primary interactive affordances and live status indicators. Backgrounds stay pure mist or slate.

rules.name: The Tri-State Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Machine and order statuses must always map unambiguously to Emerald (Available/Done), Amber (In-Cycle/Pending), or Slate (Maintenance/Cancelled).

rules.name: The Editorial Anchor Rule
rules.body: Major section titles and hero welcomes always use Playfair Display; all functional labels, form controls, and numbers must remain in Plus Jakarta Sans or monospace.

rules.name: The Tactile Feedback Rule
rules.body: All clickable cards and primary buttons must physically respond to user intent: subtle lift on hover (-1px to -2px) and compression on press (+1px to +2px).

dos: Do maintain the Playfair Display + Plus Jakarta Sans typography pairing for clear brand hierarchy.
Do use the recessed inset styling for text inputs and dropdown selectors.
Do provide immediate tactile feedback on buttons and interactive cards via subtle translateY motion.
Do use exact status mapping (Emerald = Available, Amber = In-use, Slate = Maintenance).
donts: Don't use flat, harsh black shadows (#000000); always use tinted ambient cyan/slate shadows.
Don't use generic default system sans-serif fonts; preserve Plus Jakarta Sans and Playfair Display.
Don't use aggressive, jarring bright red or neon colors outside of standard warning states.
Don't create sharp 0px rectangular cards; maintain the signature rounded form language (minimum 12px radius).
